description: Maxwell convicted as Epstein's primary operational partner in sex trafficking ring. ~400 documented flight legs together.

Black paid Epstein $158-170M (2012-2017) from 7+ entities through Deutsche Bank. Payments mapped onto Apollo Fund VIII ($18.4B) and Fund IX ($24.6B) fundraises. $62.5M USVI immunity settlement. ~$100M paid without written contract.

Palm Beach police records state Epstein told a victim he had purchased Marcinkova from her family to be his 'sex slave'. She was later an immunity grantee.

DOJ emails reveal Epstein coordinated document delay strategy, provided financial structuring advice on wire payments, and served as her crisis contact during a 2016 police bank raid. ~50 documented meetings 2013-2019.

Ariane asked Epstein 'Do you know Prince Andrew?' in October 2014 DOJ email (EFTA02516685), seeking access through Epstein's network.

Ted Waitt was Ghislaine Maxwell's long-term romantic partner (2003-2010) per Maxwell legal filings. Maxwell attended Chelsea Clinton's 2010 wedding as Waitt's guest and helped him obtain the yacht Plan B.

Epstein identified Waitt as 'Batman' in Oct 2004 email. Waitt provided monthly financial payments to at least one young woman in Epstein's network. Epstein counseled her that Waitt was 'keeping her short' to prevent independence.

Ribis served as CEO of Trump Hotels and Casino Resorts. Provided Epstein intelligence on Trump's motivations in June 2017.
Merkin relayed to Epstein that Trump was '100% behind Jimmy Cayne' in June 2011, linking the Trump, Bear Stearns, and Epstein networks.

AdFin Solutions co-investment signed December 28, 2012 (4 days after island visit). Epstein signed for Southern Trust, Lutnick for CVAFH I (Cantor Fitzgerald). Ongoing through at least May 2018. EFTA00289560.
Epstein orchestrated $2M MIT Media Lab grant and ~$8.5M in IPI grants through Gates Foundation. Proposed multibillion-dollar DAF vehicle. No direct Cascade Investment co-investments found.

Epstein brokered the JPMorgan-Highbridge Capital $1.3B acquisition (~$15-20M fee), invested $10M in Highbridge. Named Celina Dubin beneficiary of ~$50M trust. JPMorgan post-death SAR named Dubin among counterparties in $1B+ transactions.
Epstein introduced Staley to Dubin circa 1998, leading to JPMorgan's acquisition of 55% of Highbridge Capital for $1.3 billion in 2004.

Nikolic served as Gates advisor and intermediary for Gates-Epstein communications. Coordinated MIT/Gates Foundation donations through Epstein. Named backup executor in Epstein's $578M estate will.

Lutnick invited Epstein to 'a very intimate fundraising event with Hillary Clinton' (Nov 2015). Epstein donated $50,000 to UJA dinner honoring Lutnick (2017). Contact documented through at least May 2018.
